description: QoL #4 — Log search clarification + download in LogsPanel. The case-insensitive text filter + severity filter over the currently-loaded log events ALREADY EXISTS in src/rundetail/LogsPanel.tsx; keep it (document the deliberate filter-only, no-highlight choice to match the single-<pre> render). Add a PURE logsExport helper (filename + exact-loaded-lines content) with colocated unit + fast-check tests, then add a Download button that exports EXACTLY the loaded events as a .txt/.log file via the existing Blob/URL/anchor pattern, disabled when there are zero events. No refetch, no fabrication. Independent of the other features.
steps: Create frontend/src/rundetail/logsExport.ts exporting: `logFilename(parts: { runId: string; taskId?: string; stream: string }): string` -> `${runId}-${taskId ?? stream}.log` sanitized with /[^a-z0-9.\-_]+/gi -> '_' (same rule as src/reports/ReportsView.tsx); and `logContent(events: ReadonlyArray<{ timestamp: number; message: string }>): string` producing EXACTLY the loaded lines in the panel's existing on-screen format `${formatTs(timestamp)}  ${message}` joined by '\n' (empty array -> ''). Export the `formatTs` used so the panel and the helper share ONE source of truth (move/duplicate the existing formatTs logic into the helper and have LogsPanel import it).

Create frontend/src/rundetail/logsExport.test.ts: unit assertions logFilename({runId:'r1',taskId:'t1'})==='r1-t1.log', logFilename({runId:'r1',stream:'ENGINE'})==='r1-ENGINE.log', unsafe characters sanitized to '_'; logContent reproduces the exact loaded lines in order with the timestamp prefix, empty array -> ''. fast-check property: logContent's line count equals input length and every emitted line is derived from an input event (no fabricated lines); logFilename output only contains the sanitized character class.

Edit frontend/src/rundetail/LogsPanel.tsx: import logContent/logFilename/formatTs from './logsExport' and render the on-screen <pre> via the shared formatter so it cannot drift from the download. Add a short code comment documenting the deliberate decision to KEEP filter-only search (no per-line highlight spans) because the panel renders a single <pre>, matching the existing LogsPanel UX.

Edit frontend/src/rundetail/LogsPanel.tsx: add a Cloudscape Button iconName='download' (ariaLabel 'Download logs') next to the Refresh button. On click, build text = logContent(events) over the FULL loaded events (not the severity/text-filtered subset — 'exactly the loaded lines'; note this intent in a comment), create new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8;' }), URL.createObjectURL, an anchor with download = logFilename({ runId, taskId, stream }), append/click/remove, then URL.revokeObjectURL — mirroring src/reports/ReportsView.tsx. Disable the button when events.length === 0 (empty-logs guard). Keep the displayed log text unchanged.

Edit frontend/src/rundetail/LogsPanel.test.tsx: stub URL.createObjectURL/revokeObjectURL (vi.fn) and spy HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click; assert clicking Download creates a Blob URL, sets download to the expected '<runId>-<taskId|stream>.log', triggers a click, the exported text equals logContent(events), and the Download button is DISABLED when the fetched events array is empty. Restore stubs in afterEach. Keep the existing search/severity tests green.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/rundetail/logsExport.test.ts` passes including the fast-check property (>=100 iterations).
Clicking Download exports exactly the loaded events (text === logContent(events)) with filename '<runId>-<taskId-or-stream>.log'; the button is disabled when there are no events.
The existing case-insensitive search and severity filter over loaded events still work (existing LogsPanel.test.tsx cases pass).
No refetch occurs on download and no fabricated lines are produced.
`npx vitest run src/rundetail` is green and `npm run build` + `npm run lint` succeed.

findings: Implemented as a pure helper + thin React wiring. New file src/rundetail/logsExport.ts exports formatTs (moved verbatim from LogsPanel so panel + download share one source of truth), logFilename({runId,taskId?,stream}) -> `${runId}-${taskId??stream}.log` sanitized with /[^a-z0-9.\-_]+/gi -> '_' (same rule as ReportsView.tsx), and logContent(events) -> exact on-screen lines `${formatTs(ts)}  ${msg}` joined by '\n', empty array -> ''. Colocated logsExport.test.ts has unit cases + two fast-check properties (200 iterations each): line count == input length with every line derived from an input event (no fabrication), and filename only contains the sanitized character class. LogsPanel.tsx now imports formatTs/logContent/logFilename, renders the <pre> via the shared formatter, and adds a Cloudscape Button iconName='download' ariaLabel='Download logs' next to Refresh. handleDownload exports logContent over the FULL loaded events (NOT the severity/text-filtered subset) via Blob('text/plain;charset=utf-8;')/createObjectURL/anchor.download/click/remove/revokeObjectURL, mirroring ReportsView.tsx; button disabled when events.length===0; no refetch. Added a code comment documenting the deliberate filter-only (no per-line highlight) search decision because the panel renders a single <pre>. LogsPanel.test.tsx gained a 'download' describe block: stubs URL.createObjectURL/revokeObjectURL and spies HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click (restored in afterEach), asserts exported text === logContent(events), filename 'r1-t1.log' (task) and 'r1-ENGINE.log' (stream), click fired once, getRunLogs called only once (no refetch), and the button disabled when events empty. Verification: `npx vitest run src/rundetail/logsExport.test.ts src/rundetail/LogsPanel.test.tsx` 18 passed; `npx vitest run src/rundetail` 139 passed (14 files); `npm run lint` 0 errors (2 pre-existing warnings in untouched ReportsView.tsx/RunCostPanel.tsx); `npm run build` (tsc --noEmit && vite build) passed with zero type errors. node_modules was already present in the worktree; no npm install needed and package.json/package-lock.json unchanged. No new dependency, no router, pure frontend.
